title: test(lint): load the linked @objectstack/spec dist with Node, not vite's transform
body:
Fixes #23900

Clause-②: no

## What

`packages/lint`'s vitest now loads the pnpm-linked `@objectstack/spec` dist with Node instead of inlining it through vite's transform:

- `packages/lint/vitest.config.ts`: one `test.server.deps.external` entry, `/[\\/]packages[\\/]spec[\\/]dist[\\/]/`, which matches the module's realpath. Vitest's default `external` covers only node_modules, and a workspace link's realpath is `packages/spec/dist/...`, so before this every file whose graph reaches spec inlined about 33 MB of built `.mjs`. The header now says the config carries two settings and why each is package-wide.
- `packages/lint/src/vitest-spec-external.test.ts` (new) is the positive control the card asks for. It checks that the spec module the tests import (root and `/data`, resolved from `packages/lint` exactly as the sources resolve it) is the same instance Node's own loader holds. It loads the ESM entry the `exports` map names with `createRequire` (Node 22's require(esm) shares the ESM loader's module map) and asserts export identity. When the dist is inlined, vite evaluates its own copy, so the identity assertions go red.
- The two `// test-budget: 30 — whole-package import` lines on `lazy-deps.test.ts` and `runtime-lazy-deps.test.ts` are dropped (see the measurement below).

The import resolves through `exports` to `dist/` either way, so this changes only who evaluates the dist, never which bytes are under test.

## Mock census (before the change)

`git grep -nE "vi\.(mock|doMock|hoisted|unmock|importActual|importMock|spyOn)\b" -- packages/lint` at `2b274600b1`: **0** `vi.mock` / `vi.doMock` / `vi.hoisted` sites. The only hits are two `vi.spyOn(console, ...)`, which spy on a global and are unaffected. Control leg: the same `vi.mock(` spelling finds 30 files in `packages/cli/src`, so the zero is a real reading.

## Positive control: what it proves and how it goes red

Both ablations ran through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed fix `be2f7c34`, with the anchor hit and the blob change proven on disk:

| leg | config | `vitest-spec-external.test.ts` |
|---|---|---|
| fix | realpath pattern | 2/2 pass |
| ablation 1 | `external` entry deleted | 2/2 fail, at the identity assertions (lines 48 and 54), after the `typeof` / `toBeDefined` lines pass |
| ablation 2 | name-shaped `/@objectstack[\\/]spec/` (the trap `packages/cli/vitest.config.ts` records) | 2/2 fail, same lines |

Restore proof: the `vitest.config.ts` blob on disk equals HEAD's (`4ecbe245f449`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Measurement (paired, same box, under `os-verify-lock.sh`; shared-box seconds)

| reading | before (`2b274600b1`) | after |
|---|---|---|
| package run, lock hold | 84 s (141 files / 6802 tests, green) | 53 s at `be2f7c34`, 54 s at `77f016c5` (142 files / 6804 tests, green; +1 file / +2 cases = the control) |
| vitest `transform` / `import` | 23.74 s / 189.81 s | 8.05 s / 96.39 s |
| `lazy-deps.test.ts` alone, two runs | 15.01 s, 15.19 s | 6.77 s, 6.79 s |
| `runtime-lazy-deps.test.ts` alone, two runs | 14.25 s, 14.63 s | 6.79 s, 6.54 s |

**Budget lines dropped, not re-measured.** Both files now run in 6.5 to 6.8 s alone, under the 10 s `FILE_BUDGET_SECONDS` line. The lines' stated reason ("vitest's transform of ... every inlined @objectstack/spec dist bundle") is no longer true. A budget is a CI reading x 1.25, and no CI reading after the change exists yet to re-measure from. If an hourly reading later puts either file over 10 s, that reading is the measurement a re-declaration needs (ruling `6181973363` item 2).

## Acceptance notes

- `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/sdui-parser` (lint's other two workspace deps) are still inlined. The card scopes only spec, and they are not measured here.
- Cost recorded in the config comment: an externalised module cannot be `vi.mock`ed. A later test that needs to mock spec has to move the entry.
- ⛔ No test deleted, no timeout raised, no move to a slower or skipped project, no other package's config, no source change.

## Verification

- Head `e0d24934` (patch round): the control now imports `defineStack` from `@objectstack/spec` and `ObjectSchema` from `@objectstack/spec/data` by name. The root namespace import broke the repo's `no-restricted-imports` rule for `@objectstack/spec`. The identity check is unchanged.
- ESLint over the four changed files, `node --stack-size=4000 node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js --no-inline-config ...`: exit 1 on `77f016c5` (one `no-restricted-imports` error at `vitest-spec-external.test.ts:29:8`), exit 0 on `e0d24934`.
- Ablation legs re-run on `e0d24934` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. With the `external` entry deleted, and with the name-shaped `/@objectstack[\\/]spec/`, the control is 2/2 red at `:48:25` and `:54:26` (`Object.is` identity). Restore: the disk blob equals the HEAD blob `4ecbe245f449`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test` at `e0d24934`: 142/142 files, 6804/6804 tests (`VERDICT command-exit 0`, lock held 54 s).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck` (including `check:test-typecheck`) at `e0d24934`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`; the debt ledger is unchanged (2 files / 6 errors).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran ...` at `e0d24934`: 51 derived, 50 run with exit 0, 1 NOT-MEASURED (`pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 because it needs a full-repo build; CI measures it), 0 unrun. Also ran `node scripts/check-console-intercept-disarm.mjs`: exit 0.
- No publish: `@objectstack/lint`'s `files[]` is `dist`, README, CHANGELOG. None of the changed text is in the built `dist/` (0 hits), while a shipped symbol (`validateStackExpressions`) has 8 hits as the positive control.
